column3: “the entrance of Minnith” renders “until you come to Minnith”; “a very great slaughter” renders “a very great defeat.”
“his one and only child” renders “an only one.”
“You have brought me very low” renders the doubled verb; “given my word” renders “opened my mouth.”
“given your word” renders “opened your mouth”; “as you have said” renders “as it has come out of your mouth.”
“let me alone” renders “refrain from me”; NASB omits “go down” before “to the mountains.”
“had no relations with a man” renders “had not known a man.”
“yearly” renders “from days to days”; “commemorate” renders a verb that may mean “recount” or “lament.”
